groups.note: If a student has already taken CHEM 212 or its equivalent, or MATH 222 or its equivalent, the credits can be made up with elective credits. Students may take either COMP 202 or COMP 204 Students who have sufficient knowledge in a programming language should take COMP 250 rather than COMP 202.
